name: 终端
desc: 内置终端面板：真 PTY 登录 shell，一键运行当前文件（按语言挑解释器/编译器），输出流式回传，可中断、可清屏
descEn: Built-in terminal panel: a real PTY login shell with one-click Run for the current file (per-language interpreter/compiler), streaming output, interrupt and clear
features: 底部停靠面板（⌘J 开关），高度可拖拽；关掉面板会话随之结束
▶ 运行当前文件：Python / Node / TS / Go / Rust / C / C++ / Java / Swift / Ruby / PHP / Shell / HTML… 自动选命令
运行目录 = 当前文件所在目录，相对路径的输入输出符合直觉
⏹ 中断（^C，必要时补 SIGINT）、清屏、↑↓ 命令历史、退出码回显
输出去过 ANSI 控制码，长输出自动截断，不卡界面
featuresEn: Docked bottom panel (⌘J), drag to resize; closing the panel ends the session
▶ Run current file: auto-picks the command for Python / Node / TS / Go / Rust / C / C++ / Java / Swift / Ruby / PHP / Shell / HTML…
Runs in the file's own directory so relative paths behave as expected
⏹ Interrupt (^C, SIGINT fallback), clear, ↑↓ history, exit-code echo
ANSI control codes stripped, long output trimmed, never blocks the UI
author: 随手社区
